title: Design system: identity and icon set
summary: The visual identity of the web UI (web/src/design): the charter's three palettes unchanged, IBM Plex Sans and Mono, and 110 original icons drawn on a 24 grid with currentColor, mapped from the Qt buttons. The ARGOS mark is generated from the official logo generator.
